verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog search and data API, offered with an SDK, CLI, and MCP server. It does not host user-defined automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Its price-tracking webhook subscriptions are event notifications, not versioned automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
